name: dqt-ui
description: Scoring-style tree binning + PSI (numeric & categorical) + pairwise z-score bin stability over time, in an interactive UI. CLI for CI / cron. Live demo: https://dqt.gorev.space

paragraphs: The open-source scorecard monitoring UI for credit-risk, fraud and propensity teams. Tree-binned PSI, target rate per period, pairwise bin stability — the metrics scoring teams already use, with one URL to share.

If your team has been building Streamlit dashboards on top of optbinning / scorecardpy to chart bin stability and PSI over months — that's the problem DQT is built for. Drop a CSV, get a self-contained HTML report with green/yellow/red severity per feature, share via ?session=, gate CI with --fail-on=red. MIT-licensed, pure Python, single process — no Redis, no Postgres, no AGPL traps.

If you've ever needed to answer "is the score still calibrated this month?" in front of a model risk committee, you've probably built some version of this dashboard yourself — bin the feature, plot the target rate per bin per month, eyeball PSI > 0.25 cells in red. DQT is that dashboard, productised:
features: Same vocabulary: bins, PSI 0.10 / 0.25, monotonicity, IV-style
MIT, Apache-style trust profile: drops in next to internal
Deploy-friendly under 152-ФЗ / GDPR: runs fully on-prem or
CI gate that speaks to risk teams: --fail-on=red in
